correctness.rationale: The conditional mean given equilibrium age is zero, the conditional variance is q+(v-q)Z, and the conditional fourth cumulant is kappa_R Z^2 because independent Gaussian noise contributes zero fourth cumulant. Thus the mixture contributes three times the variance of the conditional variance, yielding exactly kappa_R L_2+3(v-q)^2(L_2-L_1^2), including D=0. Uniform and exponential ages give the displayed F functions. For tau>0, sinh(tau)>tau and the positive polynomial difference tau^2(24tau+7) establish the strict gap. The derivatives are positive and endpoints 0 and 1 are unattained at finite positive period, so the stated equality and threshold cases are exhaustive. An independent replay gave the no-diffusion binary roots 2.224744871391589 and 2.984704585357887. At tau=5/2, the Poisson value is a^4/132, while the deterministic value is negative since tanh(5/2)>5/6. Ordering refers to normalized cumulants; positive attenuation preserves each sign but not the numerical ordering of the original values.
residual_risks: The equilibrium-renewal law assumes a common interarrival distribution. A synchronized deterministic clock at a fixed phase does not represent the stated stationary sampling protocol.

value.rationale: The renewal-reset literature motivates evaluating protocol sensitivity at equal mean; the reset law and mean waiting time alone do not determine even the sign of the stationary fourth cumulant.
